description: Documents conforming to this schema describe a package of OpenAssetIO Traits and/or Specifications.

description.description: A description of the intended use of this package.

package.description: The package identifier. This should be universally unique across all organisations that use the API. It is a UTF-8 string, but will be conformed to a legal identifier in all target languages. Restricting the identifier to simple ASCII alpha-numeric characters, hyphens or underscores will yield broadest compatibility, with the fewest unexpected transformations.
